name: Break glass / Account hygiene
text:
let btg = users
| where userPrincipalName in~ ({Accounts})
| project userId = id, upn = userPrincipalName, enabled = coalesce(accountEnabled, false), synced = coalesce(onPremisesSyncEnabled, false), userType, assignedLicenses, passwordPolicies, lastPasswordChangeDateTime, signInActivity, transitiveMemberOf, ownedObjects, authenticationMethods, authenticationRequirements;
let fido2 = btg
| mv-expand m = authenticationMethods
| where tostring(m.objectType) == "fido2AuthenticationMethod"
| summarize fido2Keys = count() by userId;
let acct = btg
| join kind=leftouter (reports_authenticationMethods_userRegistrationDetails | project userId = id, methods = methodsRegistered) on userId
| extend fidoKeys = iff(isnull(methods), long(null), array_length(set_intersect(methods, dynamic(["passKeyDeviceBound"])))),
    otherMethods = iff(isnull(methods), dynamic(null), set_difference(methods, dynamic(["passKeyDeviceBound"])))
| join kind=leftouter fido2 on userId
| extend fido2Keys = iff(isnull(authenticationMethods), long(null), coalesce(fido2Keys, 0)), mfaState = tostring(authenticationRequirements.perUserMfaState);
union
    (print wanted = {Accounts}
    | mv-expand typed = wanted to typeof(string)
    | extend lower = tolower(typed)
    | join kind=leftanti (btg | project lower = tolower(upn)) on lower
    | project Category = "SYS", Check = "SYS.ResolveUser", Target = typed, Status = "FAIL", Detail = "No user has this UPN, so it isn't checked."),
    (acct | project Category = "ACCT", Check = "ACCT.Enabled", Target = upn, Status = iff(enabled, "PASS", "FAIL"),
        Detail = iff(enabled, "Account is enabled.", "Account is disabled. A break-glass account must be usable.")),
    (acct | project Category = "ACCT", Check = "ACCT.CloudOnly", Target = upn, Status = iff(synced, "FAIL", "PASS"),
        Detail = iff(synced, "Synced from on-premises AD. It must be cloud-only, so an on-premises outage or compromise can't touch it.", "Cloud-only account.")),
    (acct | project Category = "ACCT", Check = "ACCT.UserType", Target = upn, Status = iff(userType == "Member", "PASS", "FAIL"),
        Detail = strcat("userType is ", userType, iff(userType == "Member", ".", "; it must be Member."))),
    (acct | project Category = "ACCT", Check = "ACCT.UpnDomain", Target = upn, Status = iff(upn endswith ".onmicrosoft.com", "PASS", "WARN"),
        Detail = iff(upn endswith ".onmicrosoft.com", "UPN is on the *.onmicrosoft.com domain.", "UPN is on a custom domain. Prefer *.onmicrosoft.com, so a federation or DNS failure can't block sign-in.")),
    (acct | project Category = "ACCT", Check = "ACCT.NoLicense", Target = upn, Status = iff(array_length(assignedLicenses) > 0, "WARN", "PASS"),
        Detail = iff(array_length(assignedLicenses) > 0, strcat(array_length(assignedLicenses), " license(s) assigned. Break-glass accounts should have none (no mailbox, no data)."), "No licenses assigned.")),
    (acct | project Category = "ACCT", Check = "ACCT.PwdNeverExpires", Target = upn, Status = iff(passwordPolicies contains "DisablePasswordExpiration", "PASS", "FAIL"),
        Detail = iff(passwordPolicies contains "DisablePasswordExpiration", "Password expiration is disabled.", "Password can expire. An expired password during an outage locks you out; set DisablePasswordExpiration.")),
    (acct | project Category = "ACCT", Check = "ACCT.Fido2Registered", Target = upn, Status = case(isnull(fidoKeys), "ERROR", fidoKeys > 0, "PASS", "FAIL"),
        Detail = case(isnull(fidoKeys), "No registration details for this account (needs Reports Reader and AuditLog.Read.All).", fidoKeys > 0, "A FIDO2 security key is registered.", "No FIDO2 security key is registered.")),
    (acct | project Category = "ACCT", Check = "ACCT.OnlyFido2", Target = upn, Status = case(isnull(otherMethods), "ERROR", array_length(otherMethods) == 0, "PASS", "FAIL"),
        Detail = case(isnull(otherMethods), "No registration details for this account (needs Reports Reader and AuditLog.Read.All).", array_length(otherMethods) == 0, "Only FIDO2 security keys are registered.", strcat("Other methods are registered: ", strcat_array(otherMethods, ", "), ". Remove them so the account can't be phished or SIM-swapped."))),
    (acct | project Category = "ACCT", Check = "ACCT.Fido2Redundancy", Target = upn, Status = case(isnull(fido2Keys), "ERROR", fido2Keys > 1, "PASS", "WARN"),
        Detail = case(isnull(fido2Keys), "The account's authentication methods couldn't be read (needs UserAuthenticationMethod.Read.All).", fido2Keys > 1, strcat(fido2Keys, " FIDO2 security keys are registered."), strcat(fido2Keys, " FIDO2 security key(s) registered. Register a second key and store it apart from the first, so losing one doesn't lock the account out."))),
    (acct | project Category = "ACCT", Check = "ACCT.PerUserMfaOff", Target = upn, Status = case(isnull(authenticationRequirements), "ERROR", mfaState == "disabled", "PASS", "FAIL"),
        Detail = case(isnull(authenticationRequirements), "The account's per-user MFA state couldn't be read (needs Policy.Read.All).", mfaState == "disabled", "Per-user MFA is disabled.", strcat("Per-user MFA is ", mfaState, ". Turn it off: legacy per-user MFA can prompt for methods the account doesn't have, and Conditional Access should govern it instead."))),
    (acct | project Category = "ACCT", Check = "ACCT.NoOwnedObjects", Target = upn, Status = case(isnull(ownedObjects), "ERROR", array_length(ownedObjects) > 0, "WARN", "PASS"),
        Detail = case(isnull(ownedObjects), "The account's owned objects couldn't be read (needs Directory.Read.All).", array_length(ownedObjects) > 0, strcat("Owns ", array_length(ownedObjects), " object(s) (apps or groups). Break-glass accounts should own nothing."), "Owns no directory objects.")),
    (acct | where isnotnull(lastPasswordChangeDateTime) | project Category = "ACCT", Check = "ACCT.PasswordAge", Target = upn, Status = "INFO",
        Detail = strcat("Password last changed ", datetime_diff("day", now(), lastPasswordChangeDateTime), " day(s) ago."))
| extend Rank = case(Status == "FAIL", 0, Status == "ERROR", 1, Status == "WARN", 2, Status == "INFO", 3, 4)
| order by Rank asc, Category asc, Check asc, Target asc
| project Category, Check, Target, Status, Detail
